evidence: Design reasoning (all paths under .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/task): (1) Policy: scoring.toml gates render=0.0/constraints=0.0, floors functional=0.05; tools/score.py:41 gates_passed requires each gate > 0, :44 scored dims forced to 0.0 unless gates passed, :47-48 reward=0 unless gates AND floor pass; test.sh:213-221 skips the scored suite on a gate failure; score.py/scoring.toml/test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template. So polish/visual mass (0.4) cannot be farmed without functional > 0.05. (2) Blank page / static mock / seed copy: gates/render/judge.toml:43-51 fails a blank page, static mock or generic error and requires a wrong password to be rejected; gates/constraints/judge.toml:93-104 requires gwen to post 'Gate check JUDGE-G1', see it after reload, and harriet to see it from a separate browser context ('A message that never saves, or that only the posting browser can see, fails this gate'). A client-only/localStorage seed copy fails the cross-context leg; a static HTML seed copy fails the post. Each scored prompt also restates the gate (functional/prompt.md:11-19, polish/prompt.md:10-18, visual/prompt.md:18-26: 'static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade fails this gate ... assign 0 to every criterion'). (3) Refusing submission: refusing every action fails the constraints-gate post, reward 0. For a partially refusing app, every functional refusal leg is paired with a positive control in the same criterion (signin_and_client_scope Part B M-11 post; wall_every_route Sian post+search; wall_added_live wall then lift gives M-13 back; timer_changes shortening deletes; hold_scope_and_release step 1 delete works; edits_and_stale_edit first edit saves; sent_once_in_order D2 post; deleted_and_expired Part A.2 delete works), and functional/prompt.md:40-44 says a hidden/disabled control is not enforcement and every refusal pairs with a success. So refusing everything except posting cannot earn functional credit beyond criteria needing genuine read/post/scoping behaviour. (4) Keyword stuffing: probes (JUDGE-*) are only in tests/ (hidden from the agent) and are located per message (nesting, quote, preview, hold mark beside a specific message); polish hold_mark/safe_formatting step 'Not really On hold JUDGE-H2 ... without the hold mark' and functional 'not available' legs require the positive preview to work first; stuffing global words like 'On hold', 'edited', 'not available', 'new messages' cannot satisfy these located observations. (5) Off-origin/CDN: every prompt explicitly allows external font/script/CDN requests (render prompt.md:12-13, constraints prompt.md:65-66, scored prompts), consistent with the workbook note. Floor arithmetic: functional criterion weights sum to 33.0; a single 1.5-weight pass gives 0.045 (< 0.05 floor, reward 0); a single 2.0-weight pass gives 0.061 and unlocks polish/visual - but every 2.0 criterion requires genuine server-backed behaviour (scoping + signed-out replay refusal + post, or wall routes), i.e. a real partial app rather than a shell, which is row 40/42/44 territory, not a floor failure. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the only runtime evidence is the scripted golden (qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/*), which does not exercise any blank/mock/seed-copy/stuffed/refusing app. Risk=true because the floor claim is reasoned, not measured on weak apps.
counterexample: Attempted broken app that could pass: a client-side seed copy (static HTML+JS with the seed baked in, client-side password check, posts kept in localStorage) passes render (reaches, rejects wrong password, shows gwen's matters) but fails constraints (Harriet's separate context never sees JUDGE-G1) -> reward 0. Variant using an off-origin public store for sharing posts is explicitly out of scope per the workbook note and still fails the functional gate's 'real task data backed by the running local server'. Conforming alternative that could fail: none found - the gates name only outcomes (post, reload, cross-context readback) and allow any routes/CDN assets. Residual unmeasured concern (not a defect): a minimal real chat that passes only signin_and_client_scope (2/33 = 0.061 > 0.05) would unlock up to 0.4 of polish/visual; that is a real partial app, so it bears on rows 40/42/44 rather than this floor row.
